review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Transition Services Manager based in the United States. The Transition Services Manager oversees the planning and execution of facility transitions across power generation and industrial operations, ensuring smooth transfers into, out of, or between operations and maintenance (O&M) management. This role serves as the central point of coordination between plant owners, operational leaders, contractors, and internal project teams throughout the transition lifecycle. You will manage mobilization plans, schedules, budgets, resources, and readiness requirements while maintaining a strong focus on safety, regulatory compliance, and uninterrupted operations. The position also supports new facility construction, commissioning, ownership changes, and operational handoffs. Through effective project leadership and stakeholder collaboration, you will help ensure facilities are fully prepared for safe and reliable operation. This is a remote, full-time opportunity involving periodic travel to power plants, construction sites, and client locations. Accountabilities Transition Planning and Execution: Lead facility mobilization and demobilization plans, defining project objectives, deliverables, schedules, responsibilities, resource requirements, and budget estimates. Project Management: Monitor milestones, schedules, costs, and readiness activities, identifying and addressing variances that could affect project timelines, budgets, or successful handoffs. Site Readiness and Assessments: Coordinate facility evaluations, readiness reviews, gap assessments, and operational handoff requirements to ensure sites are prepared for management transitions. Operational Preparation: Coordinate the development and implementation of plant procedures, operating schedules, training plans, safety programs, environmental compliance requirements, and NERC readiness activities. Mobilization and Demobilization Coordination: Organize the transfer of operational responsibilities, personnel, equipment, systems, documentation, and processes to support continuity of operations. Project Meetings and Reporting: Facilitate internal and client mobilization meetings, prepare status updates, and communicate progress, risks, challenges, and recommended actions to clients and leadership. Client and Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary coordination contact for clients, internal teams, contractors, and other stakeholders, establishing clear expectations, responsibilities, and communication practices. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with existing plant leadership, incoming management teams, outgoing service providers, and project personnel to resolve issues, facilitate decisions, and maintain operational continuity. New Construction and Expansion Readiness: Support operational readiness for newly constructed facilities, generating units, and expansions at existing sites, collaborating with clients, engineering teams, EPC contractors, and plant leadership. Startup and Commissioning Preparation: Align construction schedules, staffing plans, training activities, and readiness milestones with project stakeholders to support planned startup and commercial operation dates. Personnel and Documentation Readiness: Coordinate employee orientation and training for startup teams and oversee the review of operating manuals, procedures, and other required facility documentation. Ownership and Contract Transitions: Facilitate transitions resulting from facility ownership changes, supporting the transfer of operational responsibilities and information between former and incoming owners and operating teams. Workforce Coordination: Coordinate employee transfers, recruitment, and onboarding activities with Human Resources and plant leadership to address staffing requirements and support continuity. Contractual and Operational Risk Management: Identify contractual obligations, project dependencies, and transition risks that may affect service continuity, staffing, readiness, or the start or conclusion of O&M agreements. Operational Readiness Verification: Evaluate transition progress through project reports, readiness assessments, stakeholder feedback, and onsite observations, coordinating corrective actions when deficiencies are identified. Project Closeout and Handoff: Verify completion of mobilization deliverables, document outstanding items, and facilitate the formal handoff to the responsible plant management or client team. Continuous Improvement: Prepare transition summaries and lessons learned, contributing to standardized processes and improved planning and execution across future projects. Safety and Compliance: Promote a strong safety culture, follow all applicable site requirements and procedures, and ensure transition activities prioritize regulatory and operational compliance. Additional Responsibilities: Perform other duties as assigned in support of transition services and operational objectives. Requirements Education: High school diploma or equivalent required; additional education is preferred. Professional Experience: At least 9 years of experience in project management, maintenance management, or operations management. Industry Experience: Background in power generation, industrial operations, construction, commissioning, or operations and maintenance (O&M), including facility mobilizations, readiness reviews, and operational handoffs. Technical Knowledge: Working knowledge of power generation technologies, plant systems, and the construction, startup, commissioning, and operational requirements involved in transitioning facilities into O&M management. Project Coordination: Demonstrated ability to coordinate clients, EPC contractors, vendors, plant personnel, and corporate teams to achieve project objectives and resolve mobilization challenges. Operational Readiness: Experience coordinating staffing, training, safety, maintenance, documentation, and regulatory compliance requirements during facility transitions. Project Planning and Control: Ability to manage project plans, schedules, resources, budgets, milestones, cost estimates, and risk mitigation activities. Analytical and Organizational Skills: Strong organizational and analytical capabilities, with the ability to assess readiness gaps, anticipate challenges, prioritize activities, and coordinate corrective actions. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare project reports, communicate risks, and present updates to clients, leadership, and project stakeholders. Stakeholder Management: Strong interpersonal and professional judgment, with the ability to represent the organization effectively and align transition activities with contractual requirements and operational practices. Technical Tools: Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and project planning, scheduling, tracking, and reporting tools. CMMS Experience: Familiarity with Maximo or another computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) is preferred. Experience with Smartsheet is also an advantage. Leadership and Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across teams, demonstrate initiative, encourage collaboration, and support continuous improvement. Driver's License: Valid, unrestricted U.S. driver's license in good standing is required. Travel Availability: Willingness and ability to travel to power generation facilities, construction sites, and client locations as needed. Remote Work Requirements: Ability to work effectively from a home office, with reliable internet access and a quiet, dedicated workspace. Physical Requirements: Ability to work at a computer and remain seated or standing for extended periods. Facility visits may involve walking through plant and construction areas, climbing stairs, and navigating uneven surfaces. Required personal protective equipment (PPE) must be worn in designated areas, and all site safety requirements must be followed. Work Schedule: Availability to work a standard Monday through Friday schedule, with flexibility for extended hours during travel, project milestones, startup schedules, and other project-specific requirements. Fitness for Duty: Successful completion of a post-offer physical examination and drug screening is required. Employment also includes participation in random post-employment drug screening and compliance with applicable smoking restrictions. Safety Commitment: Demonstrated commitment to maintaining a safe working environment, remaining mentally alert, and following all safety rules, warnings, and posted procedures. Benefits Salary Range: Annual compensation of $152,200–$175,100, depending on experience and qualifications. Work Arrangement: Full-time remote position. Professional Environment: Opportunity to contribute to facility transitions across the power generation, renewable energy, and industrial sectors. Project Exposure: Involvement in mobilization, commissioning, new construction, facility expansion, and operational readiness initiatives. Career Development: Opportunity to contribute to a growing organization and develop expertise across complex energy and industrial operations. review_candidates.title: Telco Network Quality & AI Automation Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Overview Holafly is a high-growth scale-up revolutionising how businesses and travellers connect to the internet abroad. Since 2018, we’ve empowered travellers in over 200 destinations worldwide with secure and reliable eSIM solutions. With a team of 500+ professionals across multiple countries, we are scaling globally to support travellers with seamless, unlimited data connectivity. We’re not just connecting people—we’re enabling freedom and peace of mind, ensuring our users stay connected from the second they land, wherever their journey takes them. The Role As our Network Quality & AI Automation Manager, you will own the end-to-end performance and reliability of Holafly’s global mobile network. Your strategic leadership directly elevates the customer experience for millions of international travellers by ensuring continuous, high-speed connectivity across all partner networks. You will be the technical authority defining what premium travel connectivity means across 200+ destinations—designing algorithmic observability, automated steering of roaming (SoR), and closed-loop remediation models that preempt service degradation before an end user ever notices. Key Responsibilities Lead Global Quality Strategy: Define and execute the network quality roadmap to establish market-leading performance benchmarks across 200+ global destinations. Drive Real-Time Observability: Implement advanced monitoring systems to track critical GTP, LTE, and 4G/5G metrics, proactively stopping service degradation before it impacts users. AI-Driven Telemetry & Predictive Intelligence Architecture: Architect and deploy intelligent network telemetry across core roaming 4G/5G signaling (GTP-C/U, S6a, Diameter, and 5GC HTTP/2 SBA), user-plane and radio traffic. Automation Systems Feeding Network Operations: Collaborate with Strategy teams to integrate AI-powered diagnostics and self-healing infrastructure that automatically resolves traffic anomalies and service degradation & network outages. Build GenAI-powered diagnostic agents and automated Root Cause Analysis (RCA) pipelines that automatically parse signaling logs, isolate fault domains, and generate comprehensive post-incident technical summaries for the Operations and Strategy teams. Develop automated playbooks and programmatic triggers that arm Operations engineers with mitigation capabilities during carrier outages. Elevate Core Partner Standards: Conduct continuous technical audits across international MNO, MVNE, and IPX interconnects to ensure strict adherence to core SLAs. Also drive key performance Indicator into our core partners and our systems to ensure these SLAs can be monitored and met. Holafly Network Quality Index (NQI) & Benchmarking: Define and continuously evolve the Holafly Network Quality Index (NQI), standardizing composite metrics across attach success, latency, throughput, coverage. Collaborate with Cx teams to bridge low-level network telemetry with user experience KPIs, retention figures, and customer sentiment metrics. Guide Cross-Functional Teams: Translate complex signaling telemetry into clear technical priorities, mentoring a high-performing operations team toward operational excellence. Qualifications 12+ years in mobile network architecture across MNO, MVNO, or MVNE environments, with proven leadership experience. Deep core network and roaming protocol mastery across EPC and 5GC architectures (MME, PGW, AMF, UPF) and roaming protocols (S6a, GTP-C/U, Diameter) and roaming protocols (GTP-C/U, Diameter S6a/Gx/Gy, HTTP/2 SBA). Hands-on expertise in capacity engineering and telemetry analysis tools like Wireshark, Prometheus, or Grafana. Track record with virtualized core platforms and cloud-native mobile ecosystem integrations. Exceptional technical communication with a natural ability to connect high-level business goals to network execution. Automation & Software Engineering: Proven experience writing robust scripts/tools in, interact with RESTful APIs, and automate complex workflows. Hands-on exposure applying Machine Learning or GenAI to telecommunications. Observability & Telemetry Stacks: Strong hands-on expertise building dashboards, alarms, and data pipelines using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/OpenSearch, or Datadog. Strategic Mindset: Strong ability to translate complex technical signaling data into actionable commercial levers, strategic roadmaps, and automated operational toolsets. Nice To Have Hands-on experience with eSIM architecture (GSMA RSP standards, SM-DP+) or cloud deployment (Kubernetes, AWS/GCP). Professional fluency in Spanish for seamless vendor collaboration. What We Offer 100% Remote & Flexible Culture: Work from anywhere with a high level of trust and ownership in Europe. Global Scale & Impact: Directly shape the connectivity experience for millions of international travelers worldwide. Growth & Innovation: Opportunity to lead 5G transformation and cloud-native telecom architecture at a fast-scaling tech enterprise. Competitive Package: Benchmark-aligned salary, performance bonuses, health coverage, and professional learning stipends. During a trip to Thailand, Pedro and Lidia, the founders of Holafly, experienced the frustration of not having an internet connection. Inspired by their own experiences, they came up with a simple but brilliant idea: why not allow travellers to buy data plans for any destination from their home country? Our passion for providing easy and convenient connectivity to travellers around the world drives everything we do. We love our work and we do it with pride. Stay connected wherever you go.

We work in the UK and around the world to fund life-saving research, influence policy, raise awareness, support people affected by meningitis and drive prevention. Through the Confederation of Meningitis Organisations (CoMO), our worldwide network of advocates, we also bring people and organisations together to strengthen awareness and advocacy and accelerate action against meningitis. We’re looking for a creative and enthusiastic Social Media and Communications Officer to help us tell our story, engage our audiences and make our voice heard. About the role This is a varied, hands-on communications role and a great opportunity for someone looking to build their career in social media and communications while working for a cause that makes a real difference. You'll help plan, create, publish and evaluate content across MRF and CoMO's social media channels, as well as supporting wider communications through campaigns, email, newsletters, blogs and website content. You'll also be involved in online community engagement and help support our day-to-day media relations activity. From developing engaging social posts and short-form content to spotting emerging conversations and helping bring campaigns to life, no two days will be quite the same. Manage day-to-day social media activity and engage with our online communities. Help deliver organic and paid social media activity and use performance insights to improve our reach and engagement. Support campaigns, awareness days, events and other activities across MRF. Monitor digital trends and social conversations to identify new opportunities. Help coordinate media enquiries, interview arrangements and media monitoring. Support Meningitis in your words, the world's largest collection of meningitis experiences. Use tools including Hootsuite and Canva to help colleagues make effective use of social media and maintain consistent ways of working. About you You don't need to have spent years working in communications. We're looking for someone with at least one year's experience in a digital communications, social media or communications role who can demonstrate creativity, strong writing skills and enthusiasm for engaging different audiences. You'll be someone who: Can write engaging content and adapt your tone for different audiences and digital channels. Has experience planning, creating, scheduling and publishing social media content. Is comfortable engaging with online communities and responding to comments and enquiries. Has excellent written communication skills and strong attention to detail. Enjoys storytelling and finding creative ways to communicate. Is organised, collaborative and comfortable juggling different priorities. Can interpret social media performance data and use it to suggest improvements. Uses sound judgement when dealing with sensitive health information and people's lived experiences. Experience creating short-form video or visual content and familiarity with social media scheduling, monitoring or listening tools would be an advantage. Experience of integrated campaigns, media relations or communications within a charity, health or membership organisation would also be welcome, but these are desirable rather than essential. If you're looking for your next step in communications and want to use your creativity for a cause with real purpose, this role offers the opportunity to work across a broad mix of social media, digital content, campaigns and communications. You'll join MRF's wider Fundraising, Marketing and Communications department and report to the Senior Communications and Campaigns Manager, working with colleagues from across the organisation and contributing to both our UK and global communications Other benefits 25 days’ annual leave , plus statutory and public holidays 6% employer pension contribution , alongside a 2% employee contribution Two paid volunteering days each year Time off in Lieu to support a healthy work-life balance Access to employee discounts through Peninsula BUPA-backed Employee Assistance Programme for you and your immediate family.
